title: IKE aggressive mode with pre-shared key

case_origin.source: Tenable vulnerability export supplied for thesis experiment

source_references.plugin_name: Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Aggressive Mode with Pre-Shared Key

experimental_selection_reason: High-severity VPN/IKE configuration weakness; selected to represent a security configuration case rather than a software patching case.

finding.plugin_name: Internet Key Exchange (IKE) Aggressive Mode with Pre-Shared Key
finding.synopsis: The remote IKEv1 service supports Aggressive Mode with Pre-Shared key.
finding.description: The remote Internet Key Exchange (IKE) version 1 service seems to support Aggressive Mode with Pre-Shared key (PSK) authentication. Such a configuration could allow an attacker to capture and crack the PSK of a VPN gateway and gain unauthorized access to private networks.
finding.recommended_remediation:
- Disable Aggressive Mode if supported.
- Do not use Pre-Shared key for authentication if it's possible.
- If using Pre-Shared key cannot be avoided, use very strong keys.
- If possible, do not allow VPN connections from any IP addresses.
